question: What salvific reward follows for the performer and his lineage?
premises: The performer uplifts twenty-one generations of his family.
The destination is the world of Viṣṇu.
inference: By uplifting twenty-one generations of his family, he goes to the world of Viṣṇu.
plain_english: Having uplifted twenty-one generations of his family, he goes to the world of Viṣṇu.
